author: omidfxt
text:
hey Enlightenme good job man Try to look where they are happening. Draw you zone and look if price is compressing toward it, then look what happened next? Did price go thorough your CP zone or first price meet another zone above/below your zone then went through it? is there any untested pocket of S/D in your CP, then what happened when price arrived there? these are good clues to looking for when you are doing your homework and finding CPs in the chart hope it helps

Regards omidFxt

hey Enlightenme from what i posted i was trying to tell you that there are a lot of compression in the chart and just spotting them do not help you much it's better try to look for them as you want to trade them. so try to draw your zones and then investigate if price compressed toward it or find compressions in the chart and investigate where did they react to and why some failed and some worked in the past in this way you can really learn from the chart and answer your own questions and about your charts they were very good

hope it was useful best regards
